verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Strix Halo/AI Max+395 ships quad-channel DDR5-8000 (high bandwidth) and up to 128GB unified memory, and hands-on users report running large quantized models (Qwen 35B-A3B, Qwen 122B-A10B) locally via llama.cpp, with AMD's own Lemonade/hybrid OGA stack listing Llama-3/Mistral/Qwen family support for local LLM deployment. However, users note memory bandwidth becomes a real bottleneck especially with long context/KV cache, and no evidence specifically benchmarks a 70B-class model's throughput as 'practical'. Missing for 10: explicit 70B dense-model quantized benchmark/tokens-per-sec figures and independent confirmation that bandwidth is sufficient for that specific model class at usable speeds.
